Name: Ability Patch and Nature Mints
Description: Bag items that change a Pokemon's ability slot or nature. Ability Patch toggles between the hidden slot and slot 1; each mint sets one nature.

abilityPatchId.Description: Item id for Ability Patch. The code.bin dispatcher compares against this directly.

mintIds.Description: Item ids for the 21 mints, in nature order: Lonely, Adamant, Naughty, Brave, Bold, Impish, Lax, Relaxed, Modest, Mild, Rash, Quiet, Calm, Gentle, Careful, Sassy, Timid, Hasty, Jolly, Naive, Serious. Order matters; the routine indexes by position.

ItemDescriptions.${abilityPatchId}: An item that swaps a Pokémon's Ability between its usual first Ability and its rare hidden Ability. Use it again to swap back.
ItemDescriptions.${mintIds[0]}: A mint with a sharp aroma. The Pokémon that eats it will grow with a raised Attack stat and a lowered Defense stat.
